mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit growth, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and real sales (RSAFS > 700000) signals robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 700000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 100 (INDPRO > 100) indicates manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate output and profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 150,000 (PAYEMS > 150000) supports sustained consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 325 (CPIAUCSL > 325) triggers aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 325 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1 > 24000) and housing starts (HOUST > 1200) signal strong aggregate demand that accelerates corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 24000 and HOUST > 1200 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 325) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) signal a monetary tightening regime that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 325 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
